proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ x y c hc hy hxy hL
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := LieAlgebra.nilpotent_ad_of_nilpotent_algebra K L
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ((LieAlgebra.ad K L x) ^ k) y = c ^ k • y := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, hxy, smul_smul, pow_succ]
  have h0 := key n
  rw [hn x, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h0
  exact (smul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero n hc) hy) h0.symm
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (L : Type*) [Field K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] (x y : L) (c : K), c ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → ⁅x, y⁆ = c • y → ¬ LieRing.IsNilpotent L
